revised_answer.example_en: I missed my alarm this morning and overslept.
revised_answer.example_zh: 今天早上我没听到闹钟，结果睡过头了。
revised_answer.usage_note: miss your alarm意为没听见或没注意到闹钟提醒；更常见的说法还有sleep through your alarm或not hear your alarm。手机静音不一定会使闹钟静音。

revised_answer.example_en: I turned on my 6:30 alarm for tomorrow morning.
revised_answer.example_zh: 我启用了明早六点半的闹钟。
